title: Triage handoff quickpad — ACME outage (scratch)
body:
Context:
- Customer: ACME Corp (enterprise, Dedicated cluster east-us-2).
- Incident: intermittent 503s observed by customer at ~2026-03-09 22:10 UTC; spike in tail latency; errors correlate with model v2.1 rollout on Dedicated pool.
- Current status: mitigation in progress, SRE taking lead on infra, CS owning customer comms. Goal of pad: concise handoff for war-room to SRE + PM + Account team; capture next actions and comm templates.

Attendees (initial): Leila (CS), Samir (SRE), Ellen (PM), Vikram (Account), Priya (Eng on-call)

Immediate agenda (10–15 min):
1) Quick sync on latest observability: what error/slo metrics moved (Samir)
2) Known recent changes: model v2.1 rollout + autoscaler config tweak (Ellen/Priya)
3) Customer impact & asks (Vikram) — earliest ETA client expects
4) Short-term mitigation options & owners (decide one)
5) Communications plan: t+30 status, t+60 status, postmortem owner
6) Action items and handoff (capture owners/due times)

Key signals (notes):
- Error pattern: 503 + connection reset; not correlated to GPU OOMs; correlates to increased request queueing.
- Traces show head request stalls at model init for some shards (KV cache warmup?).
- Rolling back to model v2.0 on a small subset reduced errors by ~60% in test cluster.
- Autoscaler config changed 03-08 18:00 UTC (lower cooldown). Could be thrashing under burst.

Hypotheses (ranked):
A) v2.1 has different memory working set -> longer cold-starts causing queue build-up under burst.
B) Aggressive autoscaler cooldown leads to frequent pod churn during traffic spikes.
C) Weird interaction between prefix caching and v2.1 weight layout -> cache misses spike.

Shortlist mitigations (fast path):
- Temporary: rollback v2.1 to v2.0 for ACME's dedicated pool (low blast radius). Owner: Priya (eng-oncall). ETA: 15–30m (if approved).
- Alternative: Pin ACME to a fallback model variant (v2.0-quant) via routing policy. Owner: Ellen. ETA: 30–45m.
- Infra: bump min replicas + increase autoscaler cooldown to reduce churn. Owner: Samir. ETA: 20–40m.
- Observability: add a high-cardinality log filter for ACME requests + increase trace sampling. Owner: Samir. ETA: 10–20m.

Customer-facing comms (templates):
- t+30 status (sent by Vikram): "We have observed elevated errors and are actively investigating. We have identified a recent model rollout as a likely cause and are testing a rollback. Next update in 30 minutes."
- t+60 status (if not resolved): include mitigation steps taken, ETA for next step, and SLA impact estimate.

Action items (explicit):
- [ ] Priya: execute rollback of ACME's model routing to v2.0 for dedicated pool; confirm health; report results to #escalations. Due: 2026-03-10T22:45Z.
- [ ] Samir: increase min replicas to 3 for ACME pool and set autoscaler cooldown=300s; monitor 503 rate. Due: 2026-03-10T22:30Z.
- [ ] Ellen: prepare rollback PR for model catalog pin and open a short-term release block for v2.1 until postmortem. Link PR in Jira. Due: 2026-03-10T23:00Z.
- [ ] Leila: draft and send t+30 status to ACME contacts; copy Vikram & Samir. Use internal template in linked Confluence. Due: 2026-03-10T22:35Z.
- [ ] Vikram: confirm customer availability for a quick conf-call if things don't stabilize in 60m. Due: 2026-03-10T22:50Z.
- [ ] Leila + Samir: if rollback reduces errors <10% then escalate to engineering reliability review and create regression test ticket. Due: 2026-03-11 (post-incident).

Notes-to-self / loose questions:
- Do we have a per-customer escape hatch to force traffic to Hosted fallback? (If yes, might be cleaner than full rollback). -- ACTION: check with platform team (Samir).
- Should billing be notified for SLA credit potential? (Ask finance/ops).
- Post-incident: need a short eval set for v2.1 performance on ACME workload (Leila + Research).

Post-meeting checklist (handoff):
- Confirm owners above in #escalations channel and pin the t+30 update.
- Create a dedicated incident ticket in Jira (CUST-2456 exists) and add all action items with owners.
- Schedule 1-hour postmortem session within 72 hours, owner: Ellen.

Backchannel snippets (save these):
- Slack: #escalations thread id: p03f9a2 (grab permalink to include in ticket).
- Customer quote: "Large parts of our UI show failures" — ask them for exact example requests & timestamps. Owner: Vikram.

Quick decisions to make in the room:
- Rollback now? (Y preferred unless there is a hard blocker).
- Increase min replicas? (low risk, do it now).

Scratchpad draft - t+30 message (copy/paste):
"Hi Ana + ACME team — quick update: we're aware of an increase in errors affecting your dedicated pool. Engineering is testing a rollback to the prior model version which should reduce the errors; infra is also increasing capacity to stabilize traffic. We'll confirm within 30 minutes and follow with next steps. — Leila (Redwood)"

End notes: keep this pad messy. Will convert to a tidy incident summary after stabilization. If you pick up ownership from me, reply here with your name and I will transfer the Jira ticket and slack thread.

-- Leila (personal quickpad)
